== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|G-42 is an experimental entity created by [[Eternity Incorporated]]. Although it possesses a draconic head and six eyes, it was not intended to be a dragon; rather, it represents an attempt to manufacture a human being by combining various monster abilities and physical components. Its identity is marked by a dark label tattooed onto its white skin. While G-42 is physically vulnerable and lacks the individual strength to defeat high-ranking beings like [[Archlord|Archlords]] or Overlords, it possesses a vast, distributed power. Instead of concentrating its energy in one place, G-42 projects its consciousness outward to establish connections with monsters, systems, and relics across the globe. This ability allows it to seize control of various elements throughout the world, making its true strength much greater than its physical form suggests.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Created by [[Eternity]] as an attempt to forge a human from monster parts and powers, G-42 is a gold-and-white dragon. This entity possesses golden feathers and six eyes, with three located on either side of its head. Although it has the ability to turn off gravity, G-42 is weaker than an Overlord or [[Archlord]] when acting alone. To compensate for this, its power is distributed elsewhere to allow it to seize control of various systems, relics, and monsters. In this manner, the dragon functions much like a [[Monarch]] reigning over a world by itself.}}
